title: docs(sharing): record the external-recipient arm on ADR-0111 D7 and the grant contract
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao9sUfiwLBMYyhPAkzpzFo9P)_

Part of #25549

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The Tier H follow-up to #25591, which landed letter A of the ruling on #25549 (record 6377844010): on a public object, a share or sharing rule is admitted for a recipient who is an `external` member of the record's organization. This PR records that decision where the governing texts live, and carries the two wording nits from the seat's contract review of #25591.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么：** 只改文字，不改行为。ADR-0111 D7 第 2 条加一行带日期的修订，写明「全员可读写」对象上的分享可以给该组织的外部成员（供应商门户用户），其他人照旧拒绝；`ISharingService.grant` 的接口说明同步改正；共享规则跳过收件人时的那句提示，补上「记录所属组织解析不出来」这种情况；一处测试注释里写错的文件名改正。

**为什么改：** #25591 已按裁决 A 落地，但 ADR 和接口说明仍写着「公开对象上的分享永远无效」，以后读文档的人（包括 AI）会被误导。ADR 属于受管文件，需要单独的 PR 由你批准。

**风险与代价（含回滚）：** 无运行时风险，提示文字改了一句（没有程序解析这句话）。回滚即还原这一个提交。

**席位意见：**

**你要做的：** 看一眼 ADR 修订那一段的措辞，同意即批准合并。

## What changes

- **ADR-0111 D7 item 2** (`docs/adr/0111-record-share-management-authority-and-verb-boundary.md`): one dated amendment paragraph under the item, the text drafted in the os-dev-report of #25591 (comment 6378915159 on #25549).
- **`ISharingService.grant` docblock** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`): "a share on a public / bypass / owner-less / `controlled_by_parent` object enforces nothing" becomes "a bypass / owner-less / `controlled_by_parent` object enforces nothing; on a public object it is admitted only for a recipient who is an `external` member of the record's organization". Comment only.
- **Review nit 1, the pass note** (`plugin-sharing` `sharing-rule-service.ts` `internalHalfNote`): the per-recipient refusal a pass skips is also raised when a record's organization cannot be resolved, which admits no recipient. The note now says so: "rows were written only for external members of each record's organization; none for the other recipients this rule expands to (internal members already reach its records, and a record whose organization could not be resolved admits no recipient)". The `note` field's docblock says the same. Two test assertions follow the text.
- **Review nit 2** (`system-caller-inert-grant.test.ts`, the `RULE_ABORTING_OBJECTS` comment): it named `external-recipient-public-object.test.ts`, which does not exist; it now points at block 3 of the same file.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25549-external-share-followup-wording.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@objectstack/spec` `patch`.
